spit.definition:
n. a narrow strip of land that juts out into the sea
n. a skewer for holding meat over a fire
n. the act of spitting (forcefully expelling saliva)
v. expel or eject (saliva or phlegm or sputum) from the mouth
spit.translation:
n. 唾液, 唾吐, 小雨, 炙叉, 一铲的深度
vt. 唾吐, 吐出, 降小雨, 用炙叉穿过
vi. 吐唾沫, 吐痰, 唾弃, 飘霏霏细雨
